title: Unit-minute state (the fidelity database row)
description: One row per unit per minute of local mean time (LMT). The central state is the Reference Timeline (RT) value; the envelope says what the record permits around it; every channel carries its own evidence label. Rows of the pilot (pilot/unit-minutes.A.jsonl) implement the required fields; the optional fields are the production extension (commanders, sub-units, alternates, casualties split).

unit.description: id in data-src/build/unit_registry.json (U-/C- prefix) or a declared sub-unit id (U-20ME-B)

t.description: HH:MM LMT of the day of the file (the day is the file's)

facing.description: degrees true, 0 = north, clockwise, direction the front looks (for a column: direction of travel)

activity.description: fine vocabulary; see PLAN.md 1.1 for the 20 fine activities of the pilot and the production extension (volley/file fire, charging, retreating, entrenching, resting, medical, captured, ...)

strength.description: men present in the footprint at this minute (muskets for infantry, men for a battery)

polygon.description: footprint ring, lon/lat (optional third value: DEM elevation in metres)

ground.description: USGS 3DEP read under the footprint (modern bare-earth surface)

ev.description: D Documented, M Measured, C Computed, E Modelled/Estimated, X Contested, U Unknown (the site vocabulary)

envelope.description: everything the record permits at this minute when every waypoint time moves inside its window, plus the position sigma

determined.description: true when the envelope fits inside the tolerance of that tier: the record forces one state

expected_match.description: Monte-Carlo P(match to RT) under the pilot uncertainty model: P1 independent windows, P2 common-mode clock error, aligned_slack3 clock-aligned with a 3 minute time slack

casualties.description: production: killed/wounded/missing/captured each as [lo, hi] with source

items.description: companies, sections, skirmish detachments, color guard: same keys as a row, with parent = unit

alternates.description: contested accounts kept beside the central state, never deleted (pilot register: defs_passA.CONTESTED C1..C7)
